bounded_catalogue.issuance: Only registered exact ForecastTask versions with approved thresholds/benchmark and eligible data; retained scope is not activation.

price_type_rule: FUND_NAV and MARKET_CLOSE are distinct tasks; do not grade one with the other. SPY may be ETF with a NAV-only source profile; it is not declared a NAV-only product.

origin_policy.deadline: issued at or after frozen information cutoff, no later than proposed issuance deadline, strictly before next eligible session open; otherwise abstain
origin_policy.nav: effective_date_is_valuation_origin; wait_for_evidenced_publication; no stale NAV promoted to current economic date

daily_clocks_proposed.retry: one missing-close retry within existing daily acquisition/retry allowance, not a new stream or added paid quota
daily_clocks_proposed.schedule_admission: require issuance deadline strictly before next eligible open and demonstrated source/processing latency; otherwise unsupported_schedule_abstain
daily_clocks_proposed.late_input: known_at greater than frozen cutoff excluded, including successful late retries; never shift cutoff or backdate
daily_clocks_proposed.issuance: wait until frozen cutoff; issued_at <= close+75minutes and issued_at < next_open; otherwise missed_origin
daily_clocks_proposed.owner_receipt: POLICY-002 (2 Nov 2026) selected these four clocks subject to source and processing verification; status stays owner_pending until that verification, as timing_checks.py requires.

maturity_policy.session: count strictly after origin on frozen local valuation calendar
maturity_policy.month: OWNER-CONFIRMED FND-DEC-002: calendar-month anniversary, preceding valid local valuation date if closed; invalid day clamp made explicit.
maturity_policy.availability: Outcome ready only when required path/actions/FX/benchmark are available; economic maturity is unchanged by publication lag

separate_scenarios.probabilities: none unless separately approved evidence supports them

price_type_note_commodities: XAU/USD and XAG/USD (owner, 2026-11-03) are spot quotes without an exchange close. Owner, 2026-11-05 (OWN-26, "Use the provider's daily bar"): the option read "Each day's value is the provider's daily bar, with its boundary recorded, once the first month proves cover." Still open (SCI-D08): Twelve Data's cover and bar time, the GBP rate pinned at that time, the price type and the calendar of valuation days. The price_type enum is not extended until then, and the listings stay unavailable_with_reason for formal tasks until cover is proven.
